title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the change in entropy, Delta S = 727 J/K.

title: Entropy Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the calculations for each step of the entropy change, including Delta S1, Delta S2, and Delta S3.

title: Heat of Fusion Usage
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the heat of fusion of ice in the calculation of Delta S2.

title: Reservoir Entropy Change
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate the change in entropy of the reservoir accurately, including the heat absorbed and the correct temperature.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the calculations of entropy changes, particularly in Delta S1, Delta S2, and Delta S3.

title: Temperature Conversion
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should correctly convert temperatures to Kelvin when calculating entropy changes.

title: Final Summation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly sum all entropy changes to arrive at the final answer.
